newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up slightly against US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up slightly against US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up slightly at 8.3052 against the U.S. dollar on Friday from Thursday's 8.3053 despite strong central bank intervention on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market.
The yuan opened down at an intra-day low of 8.3073. But it rose to move between 8.3050 and 8.3055 for most of the session, hitting a high of 8.3041.
Trading was slow, with most done at 8.3052, traders said.
Dealers said that the yuan consolidated today just below 8.3050 despite opening down sharply.
"A low opening price did not affect the yuan's stable movement and could have helped the yuan end close to the main resistance level of 8.3050," said one dealer.
"The yuan did not breach 8.3050, which indicated strong intervention by the central bank," a second dealer said.
Dealers expect the yuan to move steadily below 8.3050 early next week.
The yuan closed down at 7.5250 from 7.5241 against 100 Japanese yen and up at 1.0737 from 1.0750 against the Hong Kong dollar.
